pole_plus.label: Context-gated temporal and conditional frame openings, especially After/Once and reduced when-clauses

pole_minus.label: Reference domains for quantified claims: relative-clause restrictors, outcome denominators, and event-condition subjects

rejected_labels.label: General fronted temporal/conditional clause detector
rejected_labels.reason: Initial 0/8 strong responses, lexical alternatives Before/If/When often silent; contextual gating unresolved.

rejected_labels.label: Topically relevant procedural context explains the gate
rejected_labels.reason: Procedural context suppressed the diagnostic; related and unrelated context each produced 3/8 fires in transfer tests.

rejected_labels.label: Restrictive relative clauses alone
rejected_labels.reason: Initial 2/8; a sentence about awards from nominations without a relative clause reached 0.862, and inverse search amplified this branch.

rejected_labels.label: Generic quantification or mentions of testing/attempting
rejected_labels.reason: Plain quantification, standalone numbers, and simple tested/examined/attempts sentences stayed weak while domain restrictions and outcome denominators fired.

key_tests.name: Initial positive label
key_tests.prediction: At least 5/8 temporal or conditional frames fire; at most 1/8 controls.

key_tests.name: Initial negative label
key_tests.prediction: At least 5/8 restrictive relatives fire; at most 1/8 controls.

key_tests.name: Final positive label
key_tests.prediction: Expect 3-6/8 candidate-fire passages and 0-1/8 near misses at 0.30. The official >=5 and <=1 criterion is unchanged. Predict a higher paired mean for fire than near misses. Context is part of each input; each entry contains a short lead-in and one test sentence.

key_tests.name: Final negative label
key_tests.prediction: At least 5/8 reference-domain examples fire; at most 1/8 controls.
key_tests.result: 7/8 fire; 0/8 near misses; HELD Conditional example was 0.296; all four relatives, both denominators, and the ordinal passed.

key_tests.name: Adversarial sentence banks
key_tests.prediction: Temporal/conditional frames and restrictive relatives should beat plain clauses; unquantified relatives and lexical near misses challenge breadth.
key_tests.result: 148 entries per pole, including 92 authored entries. Positive maximum 0.269; negative numerical counterexample 0.862. Relevance annotations have documented limitations.

key_tests.name: Context and syntax diagnostics
key_tests.prediction: Procedural context boosts After/Once; quantified relative constructions beat simple clauses.
key_tests.result: Procedural After decreased from 0.183 to 0.033. Most workers I interviewed: 0.362 negative, versus The workers I interviewed: 0.185. Four ungrammatical Every workers rows excluded from interpretation.

key_tests.name: Context transfer
key_tests.prediction: Related extended context should restore positive activity more reliably than unrelated context.
key_tests.result: 0/8 target-only, 3/8 related-context, and 3/8 unrelated-context entries fired. Topical relevance did not explain the gate. Original corpus prefixes recovered strong activity.

key_tests.name: Positive inverse
key_tests.prediction: Seek off-label activation >=0.30 and on-label silence <=0.10, plus graded targets and maximum.
key_tests.result: Maximum 0.4585; silent-on-label 0.0674; leak goal failed. Best eligible off-label candidate across all goals was 0.274. No global absence claim.

key_tests.name: Negative inverse
key_tests.prediction: Seek off-label activation >=0.30 and on-label silence <=0.10.
key_tests.result: Leak goal succeeded at 0.6923; numerical-denominator near-miss reached 0.8846; maximum 1.1971. Silent winner used a nonrestrictive relative and is not counted against the strictly restrictive label.

key_tests.name: Induction, both poles
key_tests.prediction: Positive steering favors temporal function-word tokens; negative favors relative-clause tokens.
key_tests.result: Simple token-set prediction did not hold at c=2. Negative steering instead prominently promoted tested/checked/tried; c=5 and c=10 generations became repetitive. Positive direction suppresses those tokens.

key_tests.name: Signed feeder and scan audit
key_tests.prediction: Dominant source pole should explain its full-unit drop; full-prefix activations should reproduce scan values.
key_tests.result: Scan peaks reproduced within about 2%. Confirmed sources: L19/N11756-, L22/N4819+, L22/N408+, L22/N12064-.

key_tests.name: Lower-band corpus audit
key_tests.prediction: Temporal/conditional openings and reference-domain patterns should remain visible outside discovery windows.
key_tests.result: The 512-window audit found 37 positive and 39 negative tokens at or above 0.30 of corpus maximum, plus 414 positive and 655 negative tokens in [0.10,0.30). Twelve contexts per pole per band were sampled outside all original top-32 discovery windows. The main patterns recur, but the positive label has clear boundary cases and the negative pattern extends to code and Arabic.

key_tests.name: Natural-size causal ablation
key_tests.prediction: Zero only the peak position; median KL(clean || ablated) below 0.1 nats.
key_tests.result: Positive median KL 0.000519; negative 0.034725. Eight corpus peaks per pole; natural interventions, not generation stress tests.
